FINAL ANSWER: Upregulation of genes PRIMARILY drives the metabolic effects of CBD treatment in CRC cells (CBD_IC50 vs DMSO, vehicle control).

Evidence summary (all thresholds applied: padj < 0.05 AND |log2FC| > 0.5, BH-adjusted):
- GO Biological Process enrichment was significant ONLY on the UP-regulated gene set and was absent from the DOWN-regulated set (both universe framings):
  * UP: 7 significant terms (targeted universe) / 10 (full universe) — cellular response to hypoxia (fold 14.5–32, padj 0.0028/0.0002), glucose metabolic process (padj 0.0039/0.0002), glycolytic process (padj 0.0039/0.0002), monosaccharide metabolic process, glucose import, glucose transmembrane transport, carbohydrate metabolic process, glucose catabolic process, gluconeogenesis.
  * DOWN: 0 significant GO BP terms (best is amino acid transport, padj 0.16/0.06, not significant).
- The up-regulated signature is a coordinated HIF-1α-associated glycolytic switch: CA9 (+1.11), SLC2A1/GLUT1 (+0.88), SLC2A3 (+0.75), GPI (+0.71), ALDOC (+0.70), PDK1 (+0.69), ENO2 (+0.65), HK2 (+0.65), PGK1 (+0.59) — all padj < 1e-4. The down-regulated set contains only isolated hits (NQO1, PSAT1, SLC1A4, SLC7A5) with no coordinated metabolic pathway.
- Gene-level, within the curated metabolic scope: 13 genes UP-DE vs 5 DOWN-DE.
- Global DE balance supports the same direction: DESeq2-equivalent 451 DE genes (UP 304 / DOWN 147); edgeR-style cross-check UP 477 / DOWN 388 (320 shared DE genes, 100% direction concordance). UP-dominance is stable across pre-filter thresholds (rowSum 5/10/20/50) and single-sample-drop sensitivity runs.

Caveats (flagged honestly): DE was performed with a from-scratch offline Python port of the DESeq2 core (no R/Bioconductor available) with an edgeR-style exact-test cross-check; the GO annotation is an embedded curated metabolic+adjacent human GO-BP scope (no network/GO.db), so enrichment should be interpreted within that scope, not as full-GO coverage; the 30-sample serum-covariate robustness model gives a near-balanced direction (UP 576 / DOWN 640) because its "non-CBD control" set includes Untreated/serum/cisplatin arms — a different control definition — so the verdict rests on the vehicle-controlled 6-sample contrast as approved.
